levels.name: Thundering Might
levels.description: Recasting Stellar Restoration while a Lightning Stiletto is present causes Keqing to deal 50% of her ATK as AoE Electro DMG at the start point and terminus of her Blink.

levels.name: Keen Extraction
levels.description: When Keqing's Normal and Charged Attacks hit opponents affected by Electro, they have a 50% chance of producing an Elemental Particle. This effect can only occur once every 5s.

levels.name: Foreseen Reformation
levels.description: Increases the Level of Starward Sword by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Attunement
levels.description: For 10s after Keqing triggers an Electro-related Elemental Reaction, her ATK is increased by 25%.

levels.name: Beckoning Stars
levels.description: Increases the Level of Stellar Restoration by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Tenacious Star
levels.description: When initiating a Normal Attack, a Charged Attack, Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, Keqing gains a 6% Electro DMG Bonus for 8s. Effects triggered by Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts are considered independent entities.
